objective: Separate Show Faith vs Non-Show Faith Season 2 reward programs by authorized scope, preserve existing BP/QMP/token wallets and all Season1 history, block cross-track duplicate claims, and expose detailed user guidance without activating backend or production.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only BUKLOD production-like backend inspection on 2026-11-20: existing buklod_should_show_faith_content(uuid) is auth.uid-scoped and includes CHURCH, CLUSTER admin, ORGANIZATION mandatory faith, and member preference precedence; S2 disabled schema and Season1 active from previous inspection. No Supabase data changed. Base is owner-reviewed reward guide DEV, not production. Reconciled parent DEV branch's three-lane catalog-only filter in PR #997 at SHA 72e12d5a4c1ce532676c816be28350a88a01df9b; retained existing catalog, corrected literary KL as shared, and kept active S2 track derived from scope not catalog toggle.
chosenApproach: Separate future weekly mission/badge/award eligibility by server-attested user+scope+original-event mode, preserve one immutable original source and common canonical financial/reward wallet; UI follows active scope and never mints.
selectionRationale: Avoids religious participation pressure in Non-Show Faith, fake reward claims from a user mode toggle, duplicate credits during scope switching, and destructive Season 1 accounting changes. Dedicated guarded backend schema is drafted but deliberately not installed.
alternativeApproaches: Create fully separate BP/QMP/peso wallets for faith and nonfaith — rejected: duplicates financial balances, rank and monthly payouts and breaks Season1 continuity.
Allow a member to manually select a reward track independent of source scope — rejected: enables cross-scope farming and fraudulent weekly payouts.
Auto-assign mode from the current profile preference after the event — rejected: may misclassify historical rewards when users change preference or scope role.
preserveBehaviors: Legacy Season1 46 active and 16 inactive BP catalog rules and existing QMP/AdMob monetary values are unchanged.
The canonical Character 1,300 item and 469 badge catalog and all already-owned assets persist.
Existing Wall, Connect, First View AdMob and instant tabs remain unaffected; reward details remain collapsed and read-only.
The exact ten approved Season2 exclusive features, Dec 6 embargo and SHA-bound production approval remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Show Faith and Non-Show Faith have separate visible mission tables, milestone/optional badge names and four canonical award visual variants.
The UI mode derives only from active authorized scope display, never grants client-side rewards; absent/stale/suspended scope fails closed.
Six faith/neutral learning rates are matched by six clearly UNRELEASED nonfaith educational alternatives; no new BP trigger silently activated.
No private prayer, children milestone or religious affiliation qualifies for spendable tokens or cash.
Immutable event ID cannot be claimed a second time after switching modes or scopes.
Only one optional weekly financial/currency bonus per member/week across both modes; two distinct P0 learning/community receipts per valid track.
Read-only SQL adds no user-accessible RPC, no production migration, all RLS and claim flags OFF.
Existing complete 7-wallet, 19 reward-family, 1,300 item, 469 badge, 40 ranks and current S1 balances untouched.
Pass focused Node and protected feature guard, no staging or production publish without separate artifact verification.
Existing informational Show Faith/Non-Faith/Shared BP taxonomy preserved; KL literary reading is shared across both modes, not forced into faith-only completion.
